items.description: An editor for a breakpoint ramp, such as an ADSR shape or an automation curve.
items.name: envelope

items.description: A track's automation over its lane in a timeline: an envelope along the whole arrangement, under the same zoom and scroll as the clips, whose line and points alone take the pointer.
items.name: automation-envelope

items.description: A clip's recording drawn on a canvas, a column per pixel of the screen, as its clip plays it: looped, reversed, warped. It draws only what the view shows, and a zoom in the frame it happens.
items.name: clip-waveform

items.description: A clip of an arrangement on its track's lane: move it, trim and fade it, pick a fade's curve, rename it in place and act on it from its menu. A MIDI clip draws its notes across its body.
items.name: arranged-clip

items.description: Locators and time-signature changes on a timeline's lane: press one to jump there, drag it or use the arrows to move it on the grid, rename or retype it in place, delete either. With the bars of a ruler through those changes, and a hook for the commands behind them.
items.name: timeline-markers

items.description: A track's automation: a chooser of the parameter its lane shows, Volume or Pan, for its header, and that parameter's envelope over its lane, standing faint at the mix's value until it is drawn, with a hook for automation mode and the gains and pans moved by hand, which play their mix until enabled again.
items.name: track-automation

items.description: A rotary control for continuous parameters, with pointer, wheel and keyboard input.
items.name: knob

items.description: A linear slider for gain and other continuous parameters.
items.name: fader

items.description: A two-dimensional control for two parameters at once, with pointer, wheel and keyboard input.
items.name: xypad

items.description: A grid of drum pads struck by pointer, touch or keyboard, with velocity and choke groups.
items.name: pad

items.description: A piano keyboard for a MIDI pitch range, played with the pointer, touch or the keyboard.
items.name: piano

items.description: A note editor on a grid: draw, move, resize and select notes, with a playable keyboard and a velocity lane.
items.name: piano-roll

items.description: A menu that picks a root and a scale and turns the scale on or off, in parts you place, beside items of your own; one part offers the keys the notes are likeliest in (by @audio/mir-key).
items.name: scale-menu

items.description: Finds notes by what they are: a pitch, ranges of velocity, length and chance, in or out of the scale, active or not, every few, or the rest. A form, or the form in a popover.
items.name: note-find

items.description: The settings of an export in a dialog: the file's format, its bit depth or bitrate, and its level, left as it is, brought to its peak, or to a loudness target for streaming, podcasts or broadcast. Controlled: Export sends the settings
items.name: export-dialog

items.description: A menu of commands over a piano roll's notes (split, join, quantize, legato, time commands, fit to scale, chance, velocity), with their keys: items and submenus you place, beside items of your own. The commands come as data in lib/note-edits, to run from keys or a toolbar too.
items.name: note-edit-menu

items.description: A chromatic tuner on its own: the nearest note with a needle on a scale of cents, a start button and a field for the pitch of A4. Also the display alone, for a tuner of another shape.
items.name: tuner

items.description: A panel for any device: a knob per number and a toggle per switch, from its descriptors, controlled by a state a host owns.
items.name: device-panel

items.description: A track's devices in a row, each drawn by its own panel: moved by drag or by the arrow keys, folded, switched off and removed, and a device dropped from a library where it goes. Controlled, with no audio in it.
items.name: device-chain

items.description: The face of a rack: eight macros, each with a menu that maps a parameter of a device inside or lets one go, its chains with their volume, switch and solo, and the picked chain's devices, which the host draws.
items.name: rack-panel

items.description: The face of a drum rack: eight macros, sixteen pads on a bank of the 128 notes, each named for its sound and played when struck, the picked pad's voice, tune, decay and mix, a recording dropped on a pad, and the picked pad's devices, which the host draws.
items.name: drum-rack-panel

items.description: A library of devices by shelf, with a search: a device is added with Enter, a double-click or the Add button, or dragged to where it goes on a device chain.
items.name: device-browser

items.description: Every device's panel by the device's stable id, with the width it is drawn at in a row: what draws a track's chain from the ids a project stores, with the face each device has on its own page.
items.name: device-panels

items.description: A row of buttons, one per waveform, each drawn as its shape: pick one. Fed by the options of a device's choice parameter.
items.name: waveform-select

items.description: A row of buttons, one per filter type, each drawn as the response it has: low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, notch, low and high cut, low and high shelf, bell. Fed by the options of a device's choice parameter.
items.name: filter-type-select

items.description: A row of buttons, one per transfer curve, each drawn from the curve itself: you give it the function of each option, so the icon is what the device does and never drifts from it.
items.name: curve-select

items.description: A play and pause button for a demo signal: the icon follows the state, the name says what pressing it does.
items.name: play-toggle

items.description: The level of a sound across frequencies, live, on a log axis in hertz, with held peaks.
items.name: spectrum-analyzer

items.description: Curves and draggable points, for equalizers, filters and compressors.
items.name: plot

items.description: A level meter in decibels for one or more channels, with peak hold.
items.name: meter

items.description: A track's level for its header: a thin vertical meter of what the engine meters on the track's channel, silent until an engine runs.
items.name: track-level

items.description: A needle meter: a dial in dB that a live level moves, with the VU or the PPM ballistics of @audio-ui/core/meter. The needle turns outside React, so the dial does not re-render with the signal.
items.name: needle-meter

items.description: Draws audio: a seekable waveform with regions and markers, a live waveform that scrolls with the signal, and a bar visualizer.
items.name: waveform

items.description: The clip view of an arrangement's audio clip: a strip with its switch and name that rolls the view up, then Clip (start, end), Loop (switch, position, length, ÷2, ×2) and Sample (Warp, Reverse, Crop, Gain, Transpose, speed) boxes in bars.beats.16ths, the last two foldable, beside its source on a timeline of its own (overview, bar ruler, the stretch it plays or loops to drag, warp markers on the waveform).
items.name: clip-panel

items.description: The frame of a clip's detail view: a strip along its top (the caret that rolls the view up to it, the clip's switch, its name to rename, a status, actions), boxes of its properties beside its editor (ClipBox, foldable to a strip), rows, small toggles, position fields in bars.beats.16ths (parameter fields), and useClipPlayhead, where playback reads the clip's source from the arrangement's position.
items.name: clip-view

items.description: A drum clip's notes as steps, a row per pad of the drum rack that plays them: press or paint steps, sound a pad from its name, and fill a row every 2, 4 or 8 steps. The notes stay what the clip keeps, so the piano roll shows the same ones, with their velocity and chance.
items.name: drum-step-editor

items.description: The clip view of an arrangement's MIDI clip: a strip with its switch and name that rolls the view up, then Clip (start, end), Loop (switch, position, length, ÷2, ×2, Dupl. Loop), Groove (the swing, on the eighths or the sixteenths, and for a drum clip its steps or its roll), Scale (the clip's scale marked on the roll, Fit notes, and the keys the song's notes are likeliest in; on, transposing by one moves by its steps) and Notes (transpose, invert, reverse, legato, ×2, ÷2, humanize, velocity ramps) boxes, beside its piano roll (Draw, Fold, the loop brace on the ruler, keys, grid, a velocity or chance lane), or for a drum clip its steps, a row per pad. Notes are drawn a grid step at a time.
items.name: midi-clip-panel

items.description: A zoomable timeline for arrangement views and editors, with a ruler that seeks, lanes and a playhead.
items.name: timeline

items.description: A tempo field on its own: type it, step it with the arrows, or drag its unit to scrub the value.
items.name: bpm-control

items.description: A parameter's value as a field: type it, step it with the arrows (Shift for large steps, Alt for small), or drag its label or unit to scrub it, sideways or up and down, with a unit, precision and steppers.
items.name: parameter-field

items.description: A status light that glows in its tone when lit and stays a dim dot when off, blinking for an armed take: recording, signal, mute.
items.name: led

items.description: A small screen, as on a synth: the foreground as its glass and the background as lit figures, holding a reading under a caption, in light and dark alike.
items.name: lcd

items.description: An audio value as it reads, in steady monospace figures: tempo, level in dB, frequency in Hz or kHz, pan, percent, semitones, time.
items.name: value-display

items.description: A rocker switch, as on a mixer or a synth: two sides, the one pressed down sunk into the panel, upright or laid down, with a switch's role and keyboard.
items.name: rocker-switch

items.description: A button that connects the page's MIDI input, with the device's name beside it. Renders nothing when the browser has no Web MIDI.
items.name: midi-connect-control

items.description: A step grid: press a step, or drag across several, to draw a pattern.
items.name: sequencer

items.description: A compact player: play and pause, the position, a seek bar and the length.
items.name: scrubber

items.description: DAW transport controls: play, pause and stop, the position in bars, beats and sixteenths, loop and metronome toggles, tempo and time signature.
items.name: transport

items.description: The arrangement of a workstation, controlled: the loop, the ruler, the locators and time signatures, a row per track with its header, meter, automation and clips, the return and group tracks, and the row that takes files and devices dropped on it. State comes in through the arrangement's hooks and every change goes out as a command or a callback, so it runs over an engine of your own.
items.name: arrangement-view

items.description: The mixer of an arrangement, controlled: a channel for each track and return, then the main track. Each has its pan, its sends, its fader, its meter and its peak, and Solo, Mute and an Arm light; the main track reads its loudness in LUFS and stays in sight at the right while the channels scroll, and a channel moves by its name. Every change is a command of the arrangement.
items.name: mixer-view

items.description: The devices of one track of an arrangement, controlled: its chain in a row, each device drawn by its own panel, racks with their macros, chains and zones, drum racks with their pads, devices dropped from a library where they go, and the end of the chain that opens the library or adds a rack. Every change is a command of the arrangement, and what a view remembers, such as a slot folded, goes through a hook you can give.
items.name: device-view

items.description: The parts of an arrangement editor in one install: the timeline, its zoom and grid, the arrangement's state, its clips, markers and automation, track reordering and MIDI playback. block-timeline wires them into a screen.
items.name: arrangement-editor

items.description: The detector of a key: an AudioWorklet loaded once per context from a blob, which reads a signal and writes the gain a compressor would apply to it. The multiband compressor uses it.
items.name: key-detector

items.description: The auto pan as a device: a mode, a waveform, a rate and a depth, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state and the movement the oscillator makes, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: auto-pan-device

items.description: An auto pan and tremolo on the Web Audio API for an auto pan state: one oscillator that moves a stereo panner or the level of a gain, by the mode, at a rate, a depth and a waveform.
items.name: auto-pan-engine

items.description: The face of the auto pan device: what the oscillator does to the pan or the level over two seconds, over the device knobs.
items.name: auto-pan-panel

items.description: The auto pan device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/auto-pan/.
items.name: auto-pan

items.description: The binaural panner as a device: a direction, a distance, a head's size and a mix, the numbers that go on the worklet for a state, where it sits on the panel's top view and the worklet's source (the binaural panner of @audio/spatial-binaural), with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: binaural-panner-device

items.description: A binaural panner on the Web Audio API for a binaural panner state: the binaural panner of @audio/spatial-binaural in an AudioWorklet loaded from a blob, a turn across the back the short way round, the sound passing clean until it is ready.
items.name: binaural-panner-engine

items.description: The face of the binaural panner device: the head seen from above and a handle for the sound around it, its direction and its distance, over the device knobs.
items.name: binaural-panner-panel

items.description: The binaural panner device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/binaural-panner/.
items.name: binaural-panner

items.description: The bass enhancer as a device: a frequency, a drive, an amount and the share of the sub kept, the numbers that go on the worklet for a state, its two bands and the worklet's source (the bass enhancer of @audio/effect-subbass), with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: bass-enhancer-device

items.description: A bass enhancer on the Web Audio API for a bass enhancer state: the bass enhancer of @audio/effect-subbass in an AudioWorklet loaded from a blob, the sound passing clean until it is ready.
items.name: bass-enhancer-engine

items.description: The face of the bass enhancer device: the sub it takes, dashed, and the band its harmonics go to, over the device knobs.
items.name: bass-enhancer-panel

items.description: The bass enhancer device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/bass-enhancer/.
items.name: bass-enhancer

items.description: The channel EQ as a device: a low shelf, a sweepable mid bell, a high shelf, a high-pass switch and an output level, their filters as a state describes them and the curve a state plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: channel-eq-device

items.description: A channel EQ on the Web Audio API for a channel EQ state: a high-pass, a low shelf, a mid bell and a high shelf in series with an output trim, the same filters its curve draws, moving without a click.
items.name: channel-eq-engine

items.description: The face of the channel EQ device: the curve it plays with a handle on the mid band and an optional live spectrum, over the shelf knobs and the high-pass switch.
items.name: channel-eq-panel

items.description: The channel eq device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/channel-eq/.
items.name: channel-eq

items.description: The chorus as a device: a rate, a depth, a delay, one to eight voices and a mix, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, the sweep of each voice's delay time and the source of the voices' worklet (the chorus of @audio/effect-chorus), with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: chorus-device

items.description: A chorus on the Web Audio API for a chorus state: a short delay whose time an oscillator sweeps, or two to eight voices in an AudioWorklet loaded from a blob, mixed with the dry sound, moving without a click.
items.name: chorus-engine

items.description: The face of the chorus device: the delay time of each voice as its oscillator sweeps it over two seconds, over the device knobs.
items.name: chorus-panel

items.description: The chorus device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/chorus/.
items.name: chorus

items.description: The compander as a device: the level out at -90, -60, -20 and 0 dB in, an attack and a release, the numbers that go on the worklet for a state, the curve a state plays, measured from the package's own stream, and the worklet's source (the compander of @audio/dynamics-compand), with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: compander-device

items.description: A compander on the Web Audio API for a compander state: the compander of @audio/dynamics-compand in an AudioWorklet loaded from a blob, fed only while it plays, the sound passing unchanged until it is ready.
items.name: compander-engine

items.description: The face of the compander device: its transfer curve against the straight line of a clean sound, with a handle on each of its four points, over the device knobs.
items.name: compander-panel

items.description: The compander device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/compander/.
items.name: compander

items.description: The compressor as a device: its parameters and what they mean, its models (the smooth, VCA, FET, opto and vari-mu compressors of @audio/dynamics-*), the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, the curve a state plays and the source of the models' worklet, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: compressor-device

items.description: A compressor on the Web Audio API for a compressor state: the audio.js models in a worklet, the make-up after it, a dry and compressed mix, parameters that move without a click, the signal passing until the worklet is ready.
items.name: compressor-engine

items.description: The face of the compressor device: the model picked in its title bar, the transfer curve it plays, with the threshold and the level going in on it, over the device's knobs, those a model does not use drawn off.
items.name: compressor-panel

items.description: The compressor device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/compressor/.
items.name: compressor

items.description: The de-esser as a device: a frequency, an over-body level, a ratio and a range, its models (the split, band and wide band de-essers of @audio/dynamics-deesser, which tell an s by the highs over the voice's body), the numbers that go on the worklet for a state, the response a state draws and the source of the worklet, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: deesser-device

items.description: A de-esser on the Web Audio API for a de-esser state: the audio.js de-esser in a worklet, the highs passing until it is ready.
items.name: deesser-engine

items.description: The face of the de-esser device: the model picked in its title bar, what it does at each frequency with a handle at the frequency to drag across and up or down for the range, over the device knobs, those the model does not use drawn off.
items.name: deesser-panel

items.description: The deesser device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/deesser/.
items.name: deesser

items.description: The delay as a device: its mode (an echo, a ping-pong, a multitap or a grain delay), time, feedback, tone and mix, and the grain delay's pitch, spray, jitter and grain size, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, the echoes a state makes and the worklet's source, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: delay-device

items.description: A delay on the Web Audio API for a delay state: an echo that goes round a tone filter so each repeat is darker, mixed with the dry sound, with a time that bends like a tape instead of clicking, and the ping-pong, multitap and grain modes on an AudioWorklet loaded from a blob, fed only while one plays.
items.name: delay-engine

items.description: The face of the delay device: the echoes it makes, one line each and fainter as they fade, with a handle on the first to drag its time and feedback, over the device's knobs.
items.name: delay-panel

items.description: The delay device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/delay/.
items.name: delay

items.description: The distortion as a device: a curve (tanh, cubic, hard or fold, the curves of @audio/effect-distortion), a drive, a tone, a mix and an output level, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, the table of each curve and the transfer curve a state plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: distortion-device

items.description: A distortion on the Web Audio API for a distortion state: a drive gain into the table of its curve at 4x oversampling, a tone filter, mixed with the clean sound at an output level, moving without a click.
items.name: distortion-engine

items.description: The face of the distortion device: its transfer curve against the straight line of a clean sound, over the choice of the curve, each button drawn from its curve, and the device knobs.
items.name: distortion-panel

items.description: The distortion device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/distortion/.
items.name: distortion

items.description: The ducker as a device: a threshold, a ratio, a knee, a range, an attack and a release, the numbers that go on the worklet for a state, the gain it puts on the sound for a level of the key and the worklet's source (the ducker of @audio/dynamics-ducker), with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: ducker-device

items.description: A ducker on the Web Audio API for a ducker state: the ducker of @audio/dynamics-ducker in an AudioWorklet loaded from a blob, the sound on its first input and the key from the sidechain on its second, fed only while it plays, the sound passing unchanged until it is ready.
items.name: ducker-engine

items.description: The face of the ducker device: the gain it puts on the sound for each level of the key, with a handle on the threshold and the range it never goes under, over the device knobs.
items.name: ducker-panel

items.description: The ducker device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/ducker/.
items.name: ducker

items.description: The Electric Piano as an instrument device: a tine's body that barks and a bell that pings, rung down by itself, a pickup's drive and a tremolo, with four presets, and no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: electric-piano-device

items.description: One voice of the Electric Piano on the Web Audio API: noteOn strikes a note, which rings down by itself, or cuts the ringing one and strikes anew; noteOff lets it fall silent from where it got to; the drive, the tremolo and the volume follow the state without a click. A host plays chords with several.
items.name: electric-piano-engine

items.description: The face of the Electric Piano device: its four presets, its controls by what they do (tone, pickup, tremolo, output) and a keyboard that plays it. Controlled, with the notes leaving through onNoteOn and onNoteOff.
items.name: electric-piano-panel

items.description: The electric piano device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/electric-piano/.
items.name: electric-piano

items.description: The equalizer as a device: a low shelf, two bells and a high shelf with an output trim, their filters as a state describes them, and the curve a state plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: equalizer-device

items.description: An equalizer on the Web Audio API for an equalizer state: four biquad filters in series with an output trim, the same filters its curve draws, moving without a click.
items.name: equalizer-engine

items.description: The face of the equalizer device: the curve it plays with a handle on each band to drag its frequency and gain, an optional live spectrum behind it, over the device's knobs gathered by band.
items.name: equalizer-panel

items.description: The equalizer device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/equalizer/.
items.name: equalizer

items.description: The exciter as a device: a frequency, a drive and an amount, the numbers that go on the worklet for a state, the band it excites and the worklet's source (the exciter of @audio/effect-exciter), with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: exciter-device

items.description: An exciter on the Web Audio API for an exciter state: the exciter of @audio/effect-exciter in an AudioWorklet loaded from a blob, the sound passing clean until it is ready.
items.name: exciter-engine

items.description: The face of the exciter device: the band of highs it makes its harmonics from, over the device knobs.
items.name: exciter-panel

items.description: The exciter device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/exciter/.
items.name: exciter

items.description: The expander as a device: a mode (downward or upward), a threshold, a ratio, a knee, a range, an attack and a release, the numbers that go on the worklet for a state, the curve a state plays and the worklet's source (the expander of @audio/dynamics-expander), with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: expander-device

items.description: An expander on the Web Audio API for an expander state: the expander of @audio/dynamics-expander in an AudioWorklet loaded from a blob, fed only while it plays, the sound passing unchanged until it is ready.
items.name: expander-engine

items.description: The face of the expander device: the mode picked in its title bar, its transfer curve against the straight line of a clean sound with a handle on the threshold, over the device knobs.
items.name: expander-panel

items.description: The expander device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/expander/.
items.name: expander

items.description: The filter as a device: a type, a circuit (two Moog ladders, a diode ladder, a Korg35 or an Oberheim SEM), a cutoff, a resonance and a drive, the numbers that go on the circuit worklet for a state, the worklet's source, and the curve a state plays, the circuit's measured on it, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: filter-device

items.description: A filter on the Web Audio API for a filter state: the circuit an AudioWorklet loaded from a blob, the signal passing until it is ready and going round it when it is off, moving without a click.
items.name: filter-engine

items.description: The face of the filter device: the curve its circuit plays with a handle on the cutoff to drag its frequency and resonance, an optional live spectrum behind it, the circuit picked in the title bar, over the device knobs.
items.name: filter-panel

items.description: The filter device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/filter/.
items.name: filter

items.description: The frequency shifter as a device: a mode (shift or ring), the shift in hertz, the ring's frequency, the shifter's precision and a mix, the numbers that go on the worklet for a state, its latency, what it does to a note and its harmonics and the worklet's source (the frequency shifter of @audio/effect-freqshift and the ring modulator of @audio/effect-ringmod), with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: frequency-shifter-device

items.description: A frequency shifter on the Web Audio API for a frequency shifter state: an AudioWorklet loaded from a blob that plays both modes, one output each, faded by the mode, the sound passing clean until it is ready.
items.name: frequency-shifter-engine

items.description: The face of the frequency shifter device: a note and its harmonics as they go in and as they come out, over the device knobs, the mode picked in its title bar.
items.name: frequency-shifter-panel

items.description: The frequency shifter device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/frequency-shifter/.
items.name: frequency-shifter

items.description: The FM Synth as an instrument device: four operators, each a ratio, a level, a decay and a sustain, eight algorithms that wire them, feedback, an attack, a release and a vibrato, with eight presets, and no panel and no audio in it.

items.description: The face of the FM Synth device: its eight presets, what every operator shares, each operator's four controls and a keyboard that plays it. Controlled, with the notes leaving through onNoteOn and onNoteOff.
items.name: fm-synth-panel

items.description: The fm synth device in one install: its state, its Web Audio engine and its panel, to components/audio-ui/devices/fm-synth/.
items.name: fm-synth

items.description: The gate as a device: a threshold, a floor, an attack, a hold, a release and a look-ahead, the numbers that go on the worklet for a state, the source of the worklet of @audio/dynamics-gate and the curve a state plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
